predecessor.role: unchanged; its seven-test family could not be calibrated with overlapping horizons

confirmatory_test.effect: monthly Spearman IC of the full engine minus the filed EPS/price benchmark, same eligible instruments per origin
confirmatory_test.method: one-sided Bartlett studentized mean with full bandwidth (KVB, b = 1) and a Monte Carlo fixed-b reference of 100000 Gaussian series
confirmatory_test.power_note: 80% power at 120 months only under the favorable dispersion scenarios of docs/potencia-v3-familia-21.md (62-114 months in the Gaussian bound); otherwise lower. Reported as such, never extended by looking at the data.

harm_monitor.effect: annualized monthly paired log return of the net full-engine account minus the beta-matched SPY plus cash reference
harm_monitor.method: one-sided KVB as above, testing for underperformance
harm_monitor.schedule: after every 12 mature eligible months, up to 10 looks
harm_monitor.action_if_rejected: record harm and stop any use of the engine's tilts in published portfolios pending review; never extend or restart the cohort

descriptive_only: return_mse:21 with R2_OS against the expanding mean; Campbell and Thompson (2008) 0.5% monthly as the reference for economic meaning
annual reports of all three series without p-values

resolved_blockers: calibrated inference for the registered family
economic-effect magnitudes and power sized before any confirmation score
remaining_blockers: publish original full-engine forecasts with independently verifiable first capture
verify all required original source vintages, model fits, holdings and cash flows
activation.first_eligible_origin: first monthly cut after both remaining blockers are verified and recorded by a dated commit
